rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: LinkedIn returned « The redirect_uri does not match the registered value » because the user had not yet added their PROD callback URL (https://sawalismartsystems.com/api/linkedin/oauth/callback) to their LinkedIn App's Authorized redirect URLs list. The fix (new preview-redirect-uri endpoint + amber UI banner) surfaces the EXACT redirect_uri the backend will send, with a one-click copy button + explicit instructions. User must now copy the URI from the amber banner and paste it into LinkedIn Developer Portal → App → Auth → Authorized redirect URLs before clicking Connecter. Validation complete.
